title: Saffron Villa

coverImage.alt: Sunlit villa dining space with saffron and terracotta tones, lime plaster walls and an oak dining table

description: A family villa reimagined around warmth and gathering — lime-washed walls, sculptural oak and a sun-coloured palette that follows the light through the day.
concept: We treated the ground floor as one continuous courtyard. Arched thresholds replace doors, saffron textiles catch the morning sun, and terracotta floors carry warmth from the entrance to the garden.

images.alt: Sequence of arched doorways in sand and terracotta with a saffron runner
Detail of a brass sconce above saffron and green velvet cushions
Blush plaster bathroom with green marble vanity and arched mirror

title: Olive Residence

coverImage.alt: Olive green and blush bedroom with curved headboard and sea view

description: A sea-facing apartment wrapped in deep olive and soft blush, designed as a quiet retreat from the city.
concept: Colour is used as architecture: olive walls recede to frame the horizon, while blush upholstery softens every edge. Brass details add a slow, evening glow.

images.alt: Close-up of layered textiles and a travertine side table
Bathroom with blush walls and green marble
Arched hallway washed in afternoon light

title: Terra Café

coverImage.alt: Specialty café with terracotta clay walls, green tiles and saffron stools

description: A specialty coffee house shaped in clay and colour — a place to linger, rooted in the earth tones of Hadramout.
concept: Hand-finished clay walls reference the mud-brick architecture of the region, while a curved green-tiled bar anchors the room and guides guests from counter to courtyard.

images.alt: Ceramic and brass details on a travertine surface

title: Coral Studio

coverImage.alt: Creative office with coral walls, green marble meeting table and walnut shelving

description: Headquarters for a creative agency — a workplace that feels closer to a gallery than an office.
concept: A coral envelope energises the team, balanced by a monolithic green marble table that becomes the social heart of the studio.

images.alt: Material detail with brass and velvet

title: Sand & Green Kitchen

coverImage.alt: Kitchen with forest green cabinetry, terracotta zellige backsplash and travertine island

description: A family kitchen built around a sand-coloured travertine island and deep green lacquer joinery.
concept: Hand-glazed terracotta tiles bring rhythm to the backsplash while the island acts as table, workspace and meeting point.

images.alt: Adjacent bathroom in blush and green

title: Rose Boutique

coverImage.alt: Fashion boutique with blush arched alcoves, terracotta floor and green velvet curtains

description: A fashion boutique composed of blush alcoves and sculptural plinths — every garment displayed like a work of art.
concept: Arched niches create a calm rhythm along the walls; a green velvet fitting room becomes the jewel of the space.
